title: typing.io / typing.re were removed in Python 3.13: import IO, Pattern from typing

problem.description: The typing.io and typing.re pseudo-submodules warned since 3.8 and are gone in 3.13.

files.check.py:
import typing
from types_ import name

with open('x.txt', 'w') as f:
    assert name(f) == 'x.txt'
assert name.__annotations__['f'] is typing.IO

limitations.proves: The annotation resolves to typing.IO and the function works.
limitations.does_not_prove: Third-party stubs that still reference typing.io.
